entities.summary: Jurij "Jure" Zdovc is a Slovenian former professional basketball player and coach who last served as the head coach of PAOK of the Greek Basketball League and the FIBA Europe Cup. As a player, he was a 1.98 m tall point guard, who began his professional playing career with the Yugoslav Second Division club Smelt Olimpija.
